name: Ashtasidhhi Industries Limited
about: Ashtasidhhi Industries Limited engages in the ginning, spinning, weaving, manufacture, and sale of raw fabrics and other fabric materials. The company was formerly known as Gujarat Investa Limited and changed its name to Ashtasidhhi Industries Limited in October 2023. Ashtasidhhi Industries Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
